in_marathi.name: Banshidhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Lord of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banshidhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Banshidhar is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Ban, meaning lord or god, and Shidhar, meaning wealth. It is a name that signifies the god of wealth and the lord of fortune. This name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and good fortune to the one who bears it.
